title: Fluorescence Loss Assay
author: Alexander Niederau
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7mfhk3n
materials: chemically competent E. coli DH10B_gfp cells

steps.title: Transform and recover cells
steps.instruction: Take 50 µL chemically competent E. coli DH10B_gfp cells, add 3 ng plasmid (2 µL undiluted plasmid plus MQ to reach 3 ng), heat‑shock at 42 °C for 30 s, then recover in 450 µL LB for 1 h at 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Add plasmid to 50 µL competent cells (2 µL plasmid + MQ to reach 3 ng total).
Add 450 µL LB and incubate 1 hour at 37 °C.

steps.title: Label experimental and control strains
steps.instruction: Define the positive control (PC) as E. coli DH10B_gfp + pACYC184 and the negative control (NC) as E. coli DH10B + pACYC184.

steps.title: Inoculate recovered cells (preculture)
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL of the recovered culture to 198 µL M9TG + Cam15 in each well (blank B contains medium only).

substeps.instruction: Pipette 2 µL recovered cells into 198 µL M9TG + Cam15.

steps.title: Incubate preculture
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 37 °C with shaking at 900 rpm for 21–22 hours.

steps.title: Dilute preculture into fresh medium
steps.instruction: Transfer 2 µL of each 21‑hour preculture into a new 198 µL M9TG + Cam15 (one masterblock).

substeps.instruction: Pipette 2 µL preculture into 198 µL fresh M9TG + Cam15.

steps.title: Shake plate on thermoblock
steps.instruction: Place the plate on the thermoblock and shake at 900 rpm.

steps.title: Inoculate with inducer (triplicates + control)
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL of each diluted culture to 198 µL M9TG + Cam15 + inducer, preparing four masterblocks (three replicates and one control).

substeps.instruction: Pipette 2 µL diluted culture into 198 µL M9TG + Cam15 + inducer for each well.

steps.title: Incubate induced cultures
steps.instruction: Incubate the induced plate at 37 °C with shaking at 900 rpm for 21–22 hours.

steps.title: Prepare samples for measurement
steps.instruction: Mix the cultures on the thermoblock, then transfer 40 µL of each sample into 160 µL 1× PBS in four standard 96‑well plates.

substeps.instruction: Mix each well on the thermoblock.
Pipette 40 µL sample into 160 µL 1× PBS in a 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Transfer to black plates
steps.instruction: Move 100 µL from each PBS‑diluted sample into black 96‑well plates with transparent bottoms.

steps.title: Read absorbance
steps.instruction: Set plate reader to 96‑well plate, temperature setpoint 25 °C, preheat, shake fast for 0:10 (MM:SS), then read absorbance at 600 nm (full plate) with normal speed, 100 ms delay, 8 measurements per data point.

substeps.instruction: Select 96‑well plate type and set temperature to 25 °C.
Read absorbance at 600 nm, normal speed, 100 ms delay, 8 measurements per point.

steps.title: Read fluorescence
steps.instruction: Measure fluorescence on the same plate using three filter sets: excitation 395 ± 20 nm, emission 508 ± 20 nm, optics top; set gains to 50, 75, and 100 respectively, with normal speed, 100 ms delay, 10 measurements per point, and read height 8 mm.

substeps.instruction: For each set, use excitation 395 nm (bandwidth 20 nm), emission 508 nm (bandwidth 20 nm), optics top, normal speed, 100 ms delay, 10 measurements per point, read height 8 mm.
